events.title: UNDERDEEP Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: UNDERDEEP Demo is now available!Save data from the Demo will automatically carry over to the full version, so feel free to dive in and enjoy the game!Your thoughts and feedback are always welcome! I'll be sure to read through them and take them into consideration.I'll continue working to make UNDERDEEP an even better game.Thank you for your continued support of UNDERDEEP!

events.title: UNDERDEEP Release Date Confirmed for October 30!
events.summary: UNDERDEEP is officially set to launch on October 30, 2026!Ahead of the full release, a demo is also planned for release on October 16.Please note: Save data from the Demo will carry over to the full game.If you're interested in UNDERDEEP, be sure to add it to your Steam wishlist!Thank you for your continued support of UNDERDEEP!

events.title: New Gameplay Video Now Available
events.summary: Thank you for your continued support. We’ve released a new gameplay video for the game we’re currently developing. This video features gameplay from the early part of the game. We hope it gives you a better sense of the game’s atmosphere and what it actually feels like to play—something that can be difficult to fully convey through text and images alone. Watch the video here: We’ll continue working hard on development to create a game you’ll truly enjoy. Thank you again for your support!

events.title: Development Update: New Features in the Works
events.summary: This post introduces features that are currently in development for UNDERDEEP.Behavior Policy SettingsYou can set a character’s behavior policy for each tile (coordinate) on the map. events.title: UNDERDEEP Crowdfunding Is Now Live!
events.summary: Thank you, as always, for your continued support. We’re excited to announce that the UNDERDEEP crowdfunding campaign is now live! Kickstarter (Worldwide) CAMPFIRE (Japan) We’ve put together a range of reward tiers—from early access so you can play early, to customization-focused tiers that let you dive deeper into the world of UNDERDEEP.
